theorems.name: Submission.deGiorgiTM_tendsto_setIntegral_of_symmDiff
theorems.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (A : ℝ → Set (Rn N)) (H : Set (Rn N)) (g : Rn N → ℝ), (∀ᶠ r in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), NullMeasurableSet (A r) volume) → NullMeasurableSet H volume → Continuous g → HasCompactSupport g → Tendsto (fun r : ℝ ↦ volume (tsupport g ∩ symmDiff (A r) H)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0) → Tendsto (fun r : ℝ ↦ ∫ y in A r, g y) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (∫ y in H, g y))
